notes.title: New gameplay features!
notes.notes:
While we are working hard on a new game, we are still making improvements for AntVentor based on your feedback. This time we are introducing a major gameplay update. No more lost feeling during the game session.

In a new update, we are introducing a "Goals" feature. Now all you need to do is to complete step by step all the goals in the game. This way you will know exactly what to do next.

Download a new update and check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31152012/8094405c30c33419bcfeb2f450ab793fe9c44f59.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
MAJOR UPDATE:

- Major performance updates
- Double tap to switch location 
- Main character's thought bubble system improvement 
- User menu update
- Minor bug fixes

Please restart your Steam for a game update.
